text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey put on a magnificent run. 
The race stirred up immense excitement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today is a special day—Copano Rickey's 
father's birthday. Copano Rickey is 
delighted that she could make his special 
day even more exciting.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black, who had come to support, 
urged, "Why don't you sing a song with 
us?" but naturally, they politely 
declined.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next target is the Teio Sho. If Hokko 
Tarumae recovers her form, she will surely 
run, and here, she aims for a rematch.
